items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Brazil took the top song that was here, brought to a certain point here by the show composer like Cole Porter and Rodgers and Hart and Gershwin and Kern and Harold Arlen.

ctx.x: And it's blended together and it's been played down there so much, all day long, all week long, all month, all year long, all decade long, right? It's been played down there so much that actually the quality comes from quantity But you can't (go up to people always and say?) all that isn't possible and all that, it's not true. Quality is necessary. And quantity is necessary for quality. When you get it all together and that's ............ Anyway, that came out of that, that this Indian rhythm came out of it.

Even when Carmen Miranda came here thirty years ago with that little group it was a knockout. Nobody never heard anything like that. That lively way she had of coming on. Too much. Now that's the big thing, that's....... Brazil took the top song that was here, brought to a certain point here by the show composer like Cole Porter and Rodgers and Hart and Gershwin and Kern and Harold Arlen. people like that. They took that song when they began to go back here to the country music you know, when they started going…
